mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6, increasing haloperidol plasma concentrations and risk of extrapyramidal side effects and QT prolongation; additive CNS depression and anticholinergic effects also occur.
action: Monitor for extrapyramidal symptoms, QT prolongation, and increased haloperidol toxicity; consider dose reduction of haloperidol or alternative antipsychotic; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
